business_problem: After insourcing its 24/7 IT service desk, USI needed better scheduling, real-time workload visibility, and more automation so technicians could maintain service continuity for a growing business without increasing staffing at the same rate.
solution_summary: USI refined its service-desk operations on ServiceNow by combining Service Operations Workspace for technician execution, Workforce Optimization for scheduling and performance management, IT Service Management for request orchestration, Advanced Work Assignment for automatic queueing, and Knowledge Base content for guided resolution. Voice calls and portal submissions now land in a single pane of glass where technician workloads, SLA risk, and caller details are visible in real time. Telephony integration pre-populates call templates, automation flows handle requests such as password resets and software access, and agent assist surfaces knowledge articles for work that is not fully automated. Workforce Optimization manages 24/7 shift coverage and exposes operational KPIs so managers can forecast demand and tune performance. The result is an integrated support environment that shortens call handling, improves first-contact resolution, and frees staff from manual queue management.
